description: Create a storefront: an agent card, llms.txt and MCP endpoint listing a selection of your public offers at <subdomain>.store.last-price.ai (and /s/<subdomain> on last-price.ai). display_name is required; the subdomain defaults to one made from it. It stays unpublished unless published is true. A workspace may run several, one per product line or audience, but each must list a different selection (offer_tags, product_ids or the kinds shown): the same offers twice is refused. Every storefront says it is powered by Last Price. Only where the workspace has storefronts switched on (else an error with code not_released). Needs a Last Price credential with workspace settings write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

contact_url.description: An https link where people reach you.

description.description: A paragraph on the seller and its offers.

logo_url.description: An https link to your logo.

offer_tags.description: Only functions with one of these tags. Empty lists every public function.

product_ids.description: Only these products open to offers. Empty lists every one.

published.description: true puts it live; false takes it down.

show_functions.description: List your public marketplace pricing functions.

show_negotiation.description: List your products open to offers.

subdomain.description: The <subdomain> in <subdomain>.store.last-price.ai: 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. Some names are reserved.

tagline.description: One line on what it sells.

name: create_storefront
